_comment: Output dimensions the Python pipeline (processor.py + batch.py) produced on the
lab cases, recorded on 2026-08-07 immediately before that pipeline was deleted.
This is the historical reference the Swift engine was validated against. Keep it as
a sanity check: if a future change to DocumentCropCore moves these numbers a lot,
that is worth understanding, not just re-baselining.
'swift' records what the Swift CLI produced at the same commit. Where the two differ,
the difference was investigated and accepted — see the notes.
Regenerate the Swift side with: ./lab/run_regression.sh --variants crop,deskew

cases.note: Both trim the top flap; Swift's content block starts 69px higher. Residual skew after deskew is 2.00 deg (Swift) vs 4.05 deg (Python) - Swift straightens this case better. Visually equivalent crops.
exact. Residual skew 0.29 deg (Swift) vs 0.20 deg (Python).
